seo_loop.post_deploy: SiteGuru get_page_report mode=issues: metro hub + 3 sample listings -> verify/siteguru.json baseline; zero NEW issues before G4 (staging-noindex finding whitelisted)
seo_loop.day_1_post_index: get_seo_report indexation path_contains=/directory/ + GSC coverage + script sitemap curl (positive check stays in script — SiteGuru sitemap report is site-wide/negative-only)
seo_loop.timing_note: SiteGuru has no MCP audit trigger; day-1 check runs at 'first SiteGuru crawl after flip' — record crawl freshness timestamp as evidence
seo_loop.monthly: CHANGED per SiteGuru wiring check: monthly rollup is a monthly LLM cron via siteguru-seo-operations read-set (report .md + 3-line Discord summary per delivery rules) — the 'script-only, no LLM' spec was impossible (SiteGuru is MCP-only); local curl checks (sitemap membership, HTTP 200, noindex) remain script-only

unit_isolation_rule.rule: The full pipeline executes for ONE unit at a time — one metro/state runs research->build->enrich->seo->verify->deploy end-to-end before any other unit starts. No interleaving.
unit_isolation_rule.resume: On session restart, re-probe artifacts on disk; resume at last gate-passed stage.

cadence_enforcement.verify_once_per_day_rule: No two units enter VERIFY+DEPLOY on the same day until 5 units have shipped clean. Enforced by: entering VERIFY sets order[].last_verify_date; cadence check rejects a second unit entering VERIFY same day while shipped_clean_count < 5.
cadence_enforcement.stalled_rule: Unit in running/waiting >2 days without artifact progress -> status stalled + surfaced in daily note.

preflight_self_check.required: 13/13 checks pass, exit 0 — BEFORE any unit advances in any session
preflight_self_check.covers: G0.5 honest fail-closed on real research; G2.5 good/bad page (banned words in meta attributes, H1, scorer >= 85); G3 sitemap membership positive/negative; plan wiring tokens
preflight_self_check.rerun_after: any edit to scripts/directory-preflight.py, scorer, queue schema, or fixtures
